title: Shadownet error response (RFC 7807 problem+json)
description: Error response format from a Shadownet receiver, per RFC 0001 §8.8. Returned with Content-Type: application/problem+json.

type.description: Canonical error identifier. URN suffix is one of the defined Shadownet error codes.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the error.

status.description: HTTP status code matching the error type per §8.8.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation. MUST NOT leak receiver-side classification state (stranger_review, user-review status, rate-limit budget, etc.) per §8.8 / §11.
